metadata.author: Griptape, Inc.
metadata.description: ACE-Step 1.5 is an open-source music generation foundation model that combines a Language Model planner with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) synthesizer. It generates full musical compositions from text prompts and optional reference audio, supporting 10 seconds to 10 minutes of audio at commercial-grade quality. The model supports 1000+ instruments and styles, 50+ vocal languages, cover generation, selective audio repainting, vocal-to-background-music conversion, and LoRA fine-tuning.

music_generation.title: Music Generation
music_generation.description: Generate music from text prompts and audio references

metadata.description: Generate music from a text caption and optional lyrics using the ACE-Step DiT model with optional 5Hz Language Model reasoning.
Generate a cover or style-transfer version of a reference audio file, optionally guided by a new caption and lyrics.
